as_of_content:
Red '''Repair Kits''' are used to repair a Bot's health during a mission.

Green '''Revive Kits''' revive Bots if they are knocked out during a mission.

There are single and squad Repair and Revive kits, four to five tiers of kits, and separate kits for Solo Missions, [[Raid|Raids]], and [[Alliance Mission|Alliance Missions]].

They are obtained from Crystals and sometimes node rewards on solo maps, but most of the higher tier ones could only be bought in the Store for Energon.
